prompt:
Image 1 is a frame from our film and is the authority for this row's design and weathering: the low single-storey timber shopfronts across the back of the street in Image 1. Recreate one of them as a freestanding single-storey store: a modest square false front of horizontal brown planks, a shed porch roof on four thin posts across the full front, two windows either side of a plank door, a low plank boardwalk.
Framing: one single image (not a collage, not a reference sheet) of only this building, seen in a three-quarter front view from slightly above eye level, the whole building in frame from its foundation to its roofline with clear margin on every side. It fills most of the frame.
Setting: it stands alone on a plain, seamless light-grey studio backdrop with a matching grey floor. No street, no dirt road, no sky, no hills, no other buildings, no people, no animals, no vehicles, no props other than those named above.
Light: soft, even, neutral studio light from the front, no harsh shadows, no sunset glow, no warm cast, no light coming from inside windows. Glass reads as dark, slightly reflective panes.
Materials are physical and real: dark sun-cured brown planks, grey bleached edges, split shakes on the porch roof, dusty boardwalk. Photographic realism, natural colour, full-bleed image filling the whole frame; no film border, no caption, no watermark, no text, no lettering, no logos; any sign board is blank wood. Not an illustration, not a painting, no HDR, no sharpening.
